title: Efficient 5-hydroxymethylfurfural production in ChCl-based deep eutectic solvents using boric acid and metal chlorides
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,3664-3671
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00020C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hong Guo, Xinyi Ma, Zhipeng Chen, Jing Guo, Jianjun Lu
This study reveals an efficient method for the production of 5-HMF in ChCl-based DESs using boric acid and metal chlorides, explores the reaction mechanism, and compares different deep eutectic solvent systems.
